### More to Those Who Have
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/more-those-who-have
Passage: Mark 4:24-25
Points:
- Hearing Scripture faithfully means actively believing and obeying Christ's words rather than passively listening.
- Spiritual understanding is a divine gift granted to those willing to heed the message.
- The degree to which we are receptive to God's revelation determines how much insight He entrusts to us.
- God generously adds more truth to those who cherish what they have, but withdraws grace from those who neglect it.
- Believers must respond to God's Word with immediate faith and obedience rather than presumption.

### Encouragement for Today - September 27, 2005
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-27-2005-1353609.html
Passage: Luke 8:18
Points:
- Distraction and mental clutter make it difficult to perceive God's still, small voice.
- Failing to listen carefully often leads to painful misunderstandings and broken relationships.
- Believers need intentional quiet to separate themselves from life's noise and listen to the Lord.
- Listening closely to God shapes how we hear and speak with others, keeping us guarded against gossip.
